info.title: Rank Up: Android idle RPG prototype

messages.text:
"RANK UP: THE AWAKENING

Complete Mobile Idle RPG Game

Create an original 3D dark fantasy idle RPG for Android mobile devices.

The game must have realistic 3D graphics, third-person camera and autonomous character combat.

The player controls the character's development, equipment, skills, class and dungeon progression, while the character fights automatically.

IMPORTANT: Build a functional playable game, not just a visual concept or menu mockup.

1. GAME CONCEPT

The player starts as a weak Rank F hunter in a dangerous fantasy world.

The objective is to become one of the strongest hunters by defeating monsters, completing dungeons, collecting equipment, learning abilities and evolving through ranks.

The game is single-player.

2. GRAPHICS AND CAMERA

- Realistic 3D dark fantasy graphics.
- Detailed character models and monsters.
- Third-person camera following the player.
- Cinematic lighting and shadows.
- Dark medieval fantasy environments.
- Smooth animations.
- Optimized for Android mobile devices.

3. IDLE COMBAT SYSTEM

The character must fight automatically.

- Automatically detect nearby enemies.
- Automatically move towards enemies.
- Automatically perform basic attacks.
- Automatically select the next enemy.
- Enemies attack the player.
- Player and enemies have health bars.
- Character can die and respawn.
- Boss encounters with larger health bars.

The player manually activates special abilities using touchscreen buttons.

4. MANUAL SKILLS

Create four skill buttons:

1. Powerful Strike.
2. Area Attack.
3. Healing.
4. Ultimate Ability.

Each skill must have:

- Unique visual effect.
- Damage or healing values.
- Cooldown timer.
- Functional touchscreen interaction.

5. CHARACTER PROGRESSION

Create a complete RPG progression system.

Character attributes:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.

Include:

- Character level.
- Experience points.
- Gold.
- Attribute points.
- Health.
- Attack damage.
- Defense.
- Critical chance.
- Critical damage.

Enemies grant experience and gold when defeated.

6. RANK SYSTEM

Create nine character ranks:

F, E, D, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS.

The player starts at Rank F.

Higher ranks require specific levels, achievements and progression milestones.

Each rank must have:

- Unique visual design.
- Rank emblem.
- Progression requirements.
- Unlockable rewards.

Rank and character class must be separate systems.

7. CLASS SYSTEM

Create four character classes:

WARRIOR:

- Knight.
- Paladin.
- Warrior King.

ASSASSIN:

- Shadow.
- Reaper.
- Shadow Lord.

MAGE:

- Sorcerer.
- Archmage.
- Arcane Master.

NECROMANCER:

- Summoner.
- Master of the Dead.
- Undead Sovereign.

The player starts as an unclassified hunter.

Unlock classes through special quests.

Each class has different attributes, weapons, combat styles and abilities.

Allow switching between unlocked classes.

8. DUNGEON SYSTEM

Create a dungeon progression system.

Initial dungeons:

- Forgotten Catacombs.
- Abandoned Mines.
- Dark Abyss.

Each dungeon has multiple enemy encounters and a final boss.

Defeating the boss unlocks the next dungeon.

Add increasing difficulty and rewards.

For the first playable version, implement only the Forgotten Catacombs.

9. ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Initial enemy types:

- Skeleton Warrior.
- Goblin.
- Dark Creature.

Initial boss:

- Skeleton King.

Each enemy must have:

- Health.
- Attack damage.
- Defense.
- Experience reward.
- Gold reward.
- Chance to drop equipment.

10. EQUIPMENT AND INVENTORY

Create equipment slots:

- Weapon.
- Helmet.
- Chest armor.
- Gloves.
- Boots.
- Necklace.
- Ring.

Create seven equipment rarities:

- Common: White.
- Uncommon: Green.
- Rare: Blue.
- Epic: Purple.
- Legendary: Orange.
- Mythic: Red.
- Divine: Gold.

Equipment must affect character statistics.

Include inventory, equipment comparison and upgrade functionality.

11. OFFLINE PROGRESSION

Implement offline progression.

When the player exits the game:

- Save the current game state.
- Record the logout timestamp.

When the player returns:

- Calculate elapsed time.
- Simulate offline combat rewards.
- Award experience and gold.
- Calculate possible equipment rewards.
- Display an offline rewards summary.

Maximum offline reward duration: 8 hours.

12. GAME INTERFACE

Create a modern dark fantasy mobile interface.

Main screens:

- Main character screen.
- Character statistics.
- Equipment.
- Inventory.
- Skills.
- Class selection.
- Rank progression.
- Dungeon selection.
- Offline rewards.

Main combat interface must display:

- Character health.
- Enemy health.
- Experience bar.
- Character level.
- Current rank.
- Gold.
- Four manual skill buttons.

Use large touchscreen-friendly buttons.

13. SAVE SYSTEM

Implement persistent game saving.

Save:

- Character level.
- Experience.
- Gold.
- Rank.
- Class and class progression.
- Attributes.
- Equipment.
- Inventory.
- Dungeon progress.
- Skill upgrades.
- Offline timestamp.

The player's progress must remain saved after closing and reopening the application.

14. FIRST PLAYABLE VERSION

Do not attempt to implement the entire game at once.

Build the first functional version with:

- One playable 3D character.
- Third-person camera.
- Automatic combat.
- Four manual skill buttons.
- One dungeon: Forgotten Catacombs.
- Three enemy types.
- One boss: Skeleton King.
- Experience and gold.
- Basic equipment drops.
- Rank F progression.
- Persistent save system.
- Basic offline rewards.

Create the remaining systems with an expandable structure for future development.

FINAL REQUIREMENTS

Prioritize functional gameplay over visual decoration.

Do not create an open world.

Do not require manual joystick movement.

Do not create multiplayer.

Do not remove existing functionality when adding future systems.

Make the game playable on Android mobile devices with optimized performance.

The result must be a real playable idle RPG prototype.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

Core:

  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element

  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window

Navigation:

Keyboard:

Save as:

Tabs:

  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file
  state-save [filename]       saves the current storage (authentication) state to a file
  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)
  cookie-get <name>           get a specific cookie by name
  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
  cookie-delete <name>        delete a specific cookie

  localstorage-list           list all localstorage key-value pairs

  route <pattern>             mock network requests matching a url pattern

  network-state-set <state>   set the browser network state to online or offline

DevTools:
  console [min-level]         list console messages

  video-hide-actions          stop annotating actions performed on the page
  show                        show playwright dashboard

  resume                      resume the test execution
  step-over                   step over the next call in the test
  generate-locator <target>   generate a playwright locator for the given element
  highlight [target]          show (or with --hide, remove) a highlight overlay for an element; `--hide` without a target hides all page highlights.

Install:
  install                     initialize workspace
  install-browser [browser]   install browser

Browser sessions:
  list                        list browser sessions
  close-all                   close all browser sessions
  kill-all                    forcefully kill all browser sessions (for stale/zombie processes)

Global options:
  --help [command]            print help
  --json                      output response as JSON

  --version                   print version

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a functional, playable dark fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.
- Deliver the first playable version with autonomous 3D combat, skills, a dungeon boss, progression, loot, saving, and offline rewards.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat; automatic movement/targeting/attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots and rarity-based drops; equipment affects stats.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon structure; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- The repository contained no game implementation, so the assistant chose a self-contained browser game using Three.js from a CDN, procedural 3D visuals, and `localStorage`.
- Initial scope implements Forgotten Catacombs; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable systems or locked UI.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with combat HUD, touch skill buttons, navigation panels, and offline-reward modal.
- Created `styles.css` with responsive dark-fantasy mobile UI.
- Created `game.js` with procedural dungeon/hunter/enemy models, third-person camera, autonomous combat, skills, enemy waves/boss, XP/gold, item drops/equipment/upgrades, attributes, rank/class progression, dungeon UI, local saves, and capped offline rewards.
- `node --check game.js` completed without syntax errors.

### Active
- Browser verification and fixing any runtime/visual/gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a functional, playable dark-fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.
- Verify the browser game’s runtime, visuals, combat, and interface, then fix any issues found.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat with autonomous movement, targeting, attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death, and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots, rarity-based drops, equipment stat bonuses, inventory, and upgrades.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon systems; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable first version without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Because the repository had no game implementation, the game was built as a browser prototype using procedural Three.js visuals and `localStorage` saves.
- Forgotten Catacombs is the playable dungeon; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable or locked systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the combat HUD, touch skill buttons, navigation panels, and offline-reward modal.
- Created `styles.css` with responsive dark-fantasy mobile styling.
- Created `game.js` with procedural 3D dungeon, hunter and enemy models; autonomous combat; skills; waves and boss; progression; loot, equipment and upgrades; class/rank/dungeon UI; saves; and offline rewards.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Started a development server at `http://localhost:3002` and opened it in Playwright. The page loaded; console showed a missing `favicon.ico` 404 and WebGL software-rendering performance warnings, but no game runtime errors.

### Active
- Capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.
- Exercise combat and panel interactions in the browser; fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture a JPEG screenshot at a viewport no wider than 1280px and inspect it.
2. Check the browser console and interact with the skill buttons and panels; verify combat progresses and saves persist.
3. Fix any issues, rerun `node --check game.js`, and summarize verification and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and HUD markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive game interface.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, combat, progression, inventory, saves, and offline rewards.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Browser output included `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`; WebGL warnings reported `GPU stall due to ReadPixels`.

## Objective
- Build a functional, playable dark-fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.
- Verify its browser runtime, visuals, combat, and interface, then fix any issues found.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat with autonomous movement, targeting, attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death, and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots, rarity-based drops, equipment stat bonuses, inventory, and upgrades.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon systems; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable first version without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser prototype using procedural Three.js visuals and `localStorage` saves because the repository had no game implementation.
- Forgotten Catacombs is playable; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable or locked systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` implementing the game interface, procedural 3D scene, combat, progression, skills, loot, equipment, panels, saves, and offline rewards.

- Finish mobile viewport visual and interaction checks after resizing to 390×844.
- Investigate and fix any issues discovered during remaining browser checks.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Inspect the current 390×844 browser view and verify mobile HUD, navigation, and skill buttons.
2. Exercise panels and verify save persistence across reload; check browser console for runtime issues.
3. Address the known missing `/favicon.ico` 404 if appropriate, rerun `node --check game.js`, and summarize verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, navigation, skills, panels, and modal markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy interface styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, combat, progression, inventory, saves, and offline rewards.

## Objective
- Build a functional, playable dark-fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.
- Verify its browser runtime, visuals, combat, and interface, then fix any issues found.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat with autonomous movement, targeting, attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death, and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots, rarity-based drops, equipment stat bonuses, inventory, and upgrades.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon systems; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable first version without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser prototype using procedural Three.js visuals and `localStorage` saves because the repository had no game implementation.
- Forgotten Catacombs is playable; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable or locked systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` implementing the interface, procedural 3D scene, combat, progression, skills, loot, equipment, panels, saves, and offline rewards.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser checks at 1280×800 confirmed combat progression, level-ups, skills panel rendering, and Dark Heal activation.
- Resized browser to 390×844, captured a mobile screenshot, and verified the HERO and GEAR panels render and gear inventory updates.
- Reviewed browser console errors; the only reported errors are missing `/favicon.ico` requests.

### Active
- Finish mobile HUD/navigation/skill-button visual and interaction checks.
- Verify save persistence across reload and check browser console after addressing the favicon error if appropriate.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the captured 390×844 screenshot and exercise mobile navigation and skill buttons.
2. Verify `localStorage` save persistence across reload.
3. Add a favicon or otherwise resolve the `/favicon.ico` 404 if appropriate; rerun `node --check game.js`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, navigation, skills, panels, and modal markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy interface styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, combat, progression, inventory, saves, and offline rewards.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- Three.js loads from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`.
- Browser reported `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`; WebGL software-rendering warnings included `GPU stall due to ReadPixels`.
- Clicking navigation while a panel is open is intercepted by the panel overlay; close the panel before opening another.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build and verify a playable dark-fantasy idle RPG prototype, “RANK UP: THE AWAKENING,” for mobile devices.

## Requirements
- Third-person 3D dungeon combat with autonomous movement, targeting, attacks, enemy attacks, health bars, death, and respawn.
- Four touchscreen skills with effects and cooldowns; XP, gold, attributes, stats, and Rank F progression.
- Forgotten Catacombs with Skeleton Warrior, Goblin, Dark Creature, and Skeleton King.
- Equipment slots, rarity-based drops, equipment stat bonuses, inventory, and upgrades.
- Persistent saves and offline rewards capped at eight hours, with a rewards summary.
- Expandable class/rank/dungeon systems; no open world, multiplayer, or manual joystick.
- Build a playable first version without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a browser prototype using procedural Three.js visuals and `localStorage` saves because the repository had no game implementation.
- Forgotten Catacombs is playable; additional classes, ranks, and dungeons are represented as expandable or locked systems.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell, responsive interface, procedural 3D scene, combat, progression, skills, loot, equipment, panels, saves, and offline rewards in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js`.
- Verified desktop and mobile interface/combat behavior, skill activation, gear inventory display, and save persistence after reload.
- Added a data-URL favicon to `index.html`; subsequent browser load had zero console errors or warnings.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally inspect the final mobile screenshot or perform further gameplay checks.
2. Continue from the current uncommitted prototype if additional changes are requested.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, responsive HUD/navigation, panels, skills, and data-URL favicon.
- `styles.css`: Responsive dark-fantasy interface styling.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, combat, progression, inventory, saves, and offline rewards.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh`, `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` are untracked.
- Three.js and fonts load from external CDNs; observed requests returned HTTP 200.
- Browser persistence key is `rank-up-awakening-v1`.
- At 390×844, HUD, navigation, and all four skill buttons were present; reload preserved level, gold, inventory, and other saved progression.

metadata.displayText:
UPGRADE RANK UP: THE AWAKENING.

Keep all existing game systems and gameplay.

VISUAL UPGRADE:

Transform the entire visual direction into a premium realistic 3D anime dark fantasy RPG.

Art direction:

- High-quality realistic anime 3D characters.
- Realistic human proportions and detailed faces.
- Detailed hair, clothing and armor.
- Cinematic lighting and shadows.
- Detailed fantasy environments.
- Realistic monster designs.
- Beautiful magical energy effects.
- Fluid character animations.
- High-quality combat animations.
- Epic boss introduction scenes.

Use the visual atmosphere of modern dark fantasy action anime as inspiration, while creating completely original characters, monsters and environments.

MOBILE GAME SHOP:

Create a complete in-game shop with two currencies:

1. GOLD:
   Earned through automatic combat, dungeons and quests.

2. PREMIUM CRYSTALS:
   Earned through selected rewards or purchased with real money.

SHOP CATEGORIES:

- Crystal packages.
- Gold packages.
- Exclusive character skins.
- Weapon skins.
- Armor skins.
- Special cosmetic items.
- Progression packages.

REAL MONEY PURCHASE SYSTEM:

Implement Android Google Play Billing integration for digital purchases.

Requirements:

- Display prices in EUR.
- Use Google Play's official purchase flow.
- Verify purchase transactions securely.
- Deliver purchased products automatically.
- Prevent duplicate purchases.
- Support restoration of eligible purchases.
- Save purchased items to the player's account.
- Never store bank card details inside the game.
- Do not simulate successful purchases without a real transaction.

SHOP INTERFACE:

Create a premium dark fantasy shop with:

- Product images.
- Product descriptions.
- Crystal prices.
- Real money prices.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Upgrade **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING** with a premium dark-fantasy presentation and complete shop UI while preserving gameplay.
- Prepare the browser prototype for future Google Play Billing without simulating payments or granting paid products client-side.

## Requirements
- Preserve combat, dungeon, progression, offline rewards, and existing systems.
- Support gold and premium crystals, shop categories, product details, ownership/equipping, purchase confirmation, and purchase history.
- Real-money transactions require native Google Play Billing, trusted receipt verification, duplicate prevention, eligible restoration, and account persistence; never store card data or simulate successful payments.
- Improve characters, environments, animations, effects, and boss introductions for Android-friendly presentation.

## Decisions
- The game remains a browser prototype; real-money purchases require a native Android billing bridge and trusted backend.
- The web client must not grant paid products.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added shop entry points, crystal HUD, shop catalog/categories, milestone crystal claims, purchase confirmation, cosmetic ownership/equipping, purchase history, and restore controls.
- Added `window.rankUpBilling`; real-money requests/restoration call optional `window.AndroidBilling` methods and do not grant products.
- Added boss-introduction overlay and shop skin application.
- Enhanced dungeon, hunter, enemies, and combat effects in `game.js`; added responsive shop/HUD styling in `styles.css`.
- `node --check --input-type=module < game.js` passed.
- Browser checks passed: shop rendering and categories, crystal purchase/equipping, milestone claims, browser billing-unavailable behavior without paid grants, and 390px mobile layout without horizontal overflow; no browser JS errors observed.

### Active
- Continue reviewing visual enhancements and verify existing gameplay behavior and mobile presentation.
- Perform final syntax and diff checks.

### Blocked
- Actual Google Play transaction processing, trusted receipt verification, restoration, and account-level persistence require native Android billing integration and a trusted backend, neither present in this browser prototype.

## Next Move
1. Continue visual and gameplay review; fix any integration issues found.
2. Run final syntax, mobile, and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Gameplay, shop/billing integration, and 3D visuals.
- `index.html`: HUD, shop entry points, navigation, and boss-introduction markup.
- `styles.css`: Responsive shop, HUD, and boss-introduction styling.

## Important Context
- Existing save key is `rank-up-awakening-v1`; state loading merges saved data with fresh defaults.
- Billing bridge methods are `AndroidBilling.launchPurchaseFlow` and `AndroidBilling.restorePurchases`.
- `window.rankUpBilling` exposes `requestPurchase`, `restorePurchases`, and the native billing/trusted server verification contract; browser never grants paid items.
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in the current repository state.
- Browser checks used Chromium via a temporary local HTTP server; test scripts and screenshots were placed under `/tmp/opencode/`.

UPGRADE RANK UP: THE AWAKENING — COMPLETE MONETIZATION SYSTEM.

Keep all existing game mechanics, characters, classes, ranks, dungeons, automatic combat and offline progression.

Create a complete Free-to-Play monetization system for an Android 3D anime-style idle RPG.

1. GAME CURRENCIES

GOLD:

- Earned through gameplay.
- Used to upgrade equipment and buy basic items.

PREMIUM CRYSTALS:

- Earned through selected achievements and events.
- Purchased with real money through Google Play Billing.
- Used to purchase premium products.

2. PREMIUM SHOP

Create the following categories:

- Crystal packages.
- Gold packages.
- Equipment packages.
- Progression packages.
- Character skins.
- Weapon skins.
- Armor skins.
- Special effects.
- VIP membership.

3. CRYSTAL PACKAGES

Create these proposed product packages:

- 100 crystals: €0.99
- 550 crystals: €4.99
- 1,200 crystals: €9.99
- 2,600 crystals: €19.99
- 7,000 crystals: €49.99
- 15,000 crystals: €99.99

Use actual localized Google Play product prices when available. These amounts are initial pricing proposals.

4. PAID PROGRESSION

Allow players to purchase optional progression advantages:

- Experience boosters.
- Gold boosters.
- Equipment upgrade materials.
- Inventory expansions.
- Special equipment.
- Additional offline reward capacity.

Purchases must never be required to unlock the highest ranks or complete the main game.

5. VIP MEMBERSHIP

Create an optional monthly VIP subscription.

Proposed price: €4.99/month.

Benefits:

- 20% additional gold.
- 20% additional experience.
- Daily VIP rewards.
- Exclusive VIP character skin.
- Additional inventory space.
- VIP membership indicator.

Display subscription terms, renewal information and cancellation instructions clearly.

6. REWARDED ADVERTISEMENTS

Implement optional rewarded advertisements.

Proposed daily limit: 5 rewarded ads.

Possible rewards:

- Additional gold.
- Additional experience.
- Dungeon rewards.
- Upgrade materials.
- Offline reward bonuses.

Use a rewarded advertising SDK such as Google AdMob.

Only award rewards after successful confirmation that the advertisement was completed.

Never interrupt normal gameplay with unexpected advertisements.

7. GOOGLE PLAY BILLING

Prepare native Android Google Play Billing integration.

Requirements:

- Retrieve actual product information and localized prices.
- Support one-time digital purchases.
- Support subscriptions.
- Verify purchase transactions securely.
- Prevent duplicate rewards.
- Support eligible purchase restoration.
- Handle failed and cancelled purchases.
- Record transaction identifiers and purchase status.
- Never store bank card details.
- Never simulate successful real-money transactions.

Use secure server-side purchase verification where supported.

8. SHOP DESIGN

Create a premium dark fantasy anime 3D shop interface.

Use:

- Black and dark backgrounds.
- Gold accents.
- Glowing blue crystals.
- Detailed product illustrations.
- Premium product cards.
- Clear purchase buttons.
- Crystal balance indicator.

9. FAIR PROGRESSION

Maintain a complete free progression path.

Players must be able to:

- Reach Rank SSS without spending money.
- Unlock every class through gameplay.
- Complete all main dungeons.
- Obtain powerful equipment through gameplay.

Paid purchases may accelerate progression but must not make free progression impossible.

Do not introduce paid random loot boxes in this initial version.

10. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

If native billing or advertising integration is not supported by the game generation platform, create functional shop interfaces with clearly marked integration points.

Do not simulate actual purchases.

Do not break existing game functionality.

Prioritize a stable and expandable Android game architecture.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Implement AETHER as the premium currency in **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING**, preserving gameplay and existing monetization systems.
- Complete the shop, free-reward, transaction, presentation, and safe integration work without simulating browser purchases or ads.

## Requirements
- Use electric-blue/cyan crystal visuals with Shard, Crystal, and Core representations; Crystal is the main currency.
- Show Aether on the main screen, character menu, inventory, shop, and reward screens.
- Support one-time free rewards: daily quest (5), all daily quests (additional 10), weekly quest (25), first dungeon boss (15), achievements (20–100), and events (25–200); prevent duplicate achievement rewards and unlimited farming.
- Offer Google Play packages: 100 (€0.99), 550 (€4.99), 1,200 (€9.99), 2,600 (€19.99), 7,000 (€49.99), and 15,000 (€99.99); use localized prices when available.
- Add configurable products: special skin (1,000), legendary skin (2,000), weapon appearance (500), aura (750), one-hour XP and gold boosters (150 each), upgrade materials (200), inventory expansion (300), and evolution materials (500).
- Persist balances, record every currency transaction, prevent negative balances and duplicate grants, and support refunds/reversals; never trust client-side premium balance changes.
- Preserve free paths to Rank SSS and meaningful progression; avoid pay-to-win gear.
- Add crystal visuals and smooth reward, spending, shop-opening, and package-purchase animations.
- Integrate Google Play Billing where available; otherwise show a prepared interface without simulating purchases.

## Decisions
- The game remains a browser prototype; real-money purchases require native Google Play Billing and trusted server-side verification.
- Browser billing remains unavailable without the native bridge and does not grant paid items.
- Paid products must not deliver items in-browser; purchase-card details are never stored.
- Existing browser shop purchases use Aether for non-paid products; paid package delivery remains server-controlled.

## Work State
### Completed
- Existing shop entry points, crystal HUD, milestone crystal claims, purchase confirmation/history, cosmetic ownership/equipping, and restore controls were reported in place.
- `window.rankUpBilling` requests/restoration call optional `window.AndroidBilling` methods without delivering paid products.
- Replaced the old three-package catalog with six requested Aether packages and added the requested cosmetic, booster, and material product entries in `game.js`.

### Active
- Align currency terminology/displays, free rewards, transaction ledger, duplicate-prevention, reversals, and secure integration behavior.
- Add the required Aether crystal representations and polish animations/presentation.
- Verify catalog rendering and purchase/reward flows after the recent catalog edit.

### Blocked
- Actual localized Google Play pricing, transactions, trusted receipt verification, subscription lifecycle/restoration, and account persistence require native Android billing and a trusted backend, neither present.
- Rewarded ads require an advertising SDK/native integration not present.

## Next Move
1. Update `game.js` state, reward definitions, transaction handling, and product delivery safeguards; ensure newly added products’ booster/material/expansion effects are implemented consistently.
2. Update `index.html` and `styles.css` for Aether displays, cyan crystal visuals, and the requested polished transitions.
3. Run syntax and browser-flow checks; keep real-money delivery disabled in the web client.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Currency state, HUD, rewards, shop catalog/rendering, billing bridge, persistence, and purchase actions.
- `index.html`: HUD, shop entry points, panels, and navigation.
- `styles.css`: Currency, shop, HUD, and responsive presentation.

## Important Context
- Save key: `rank-up-awakening-v1`; state loading merges saved data with fresh defaults.
- Existing state includes `crystals`, `claimedCrystalRewards`, `purchaseHistory`, and `deliveredTransactions`.
- Existing bridge methods: `AndroidBilling.launchPurchaseFlow` and `AndroidBilling.restorePurchases`.
- `game.js` still uses “crystals” internally; the catalog update maps Aether package names and quantities onto `crystals`.
- Existing `SHOP_REWARDS` still provide 35 for first boss, 20 for level 5, and 25 for 25 kills; requested reward schedule is not implemented.
- Repository changes are uncommitted; project files were reported as untracked.

metadata.displayText:
RANK UP: THE AWAKENING — ADVANCED EQUIPMENT AND LOOT SYSTEM.

Expand the existing game without removing any existing functionality.

Create a complete equipment, item rarity, random attributes and dungeon loot system.

VISUAL STYLE:
Realistic anime 3D dark fantasy.
High-quality detailed weapons, armor and magical artifacts.
Premium RPG inventory interface.

1. EQUIPMENT RARITIES

Create eight equipment rarities:

- Common: Gray.
- Uncommon: Green.
- Rare: Blue.
- Epic: Purple.
- Legendary: Orange.
- Mythic: Red.
- Divine: Gold.
- Transcendent: Cyan.

Each rarity must have different visual effects, item borders and drop probabilities.

2. EQUIPMENT SLOTS

Create:

- Main weapon.
- Helmet.
- Chest armor.
- Gloves.
- Boots.
- Necklace.
- Ring.
- Artifact.

3. WEAPON TYPES

Warrior:

- Swords.
- Greatswords.
- Axes.
- Shields.

Assassin:

- Daggers.
- Dual blades.

Mage:

- Magical staffs.
- Wands.

Necromancer:

- Dark staffs.
- Summoning artifacts.

4. RANDOM ITEM ATTRIBUTES

Generate random attributes for equipment:

- Strength.
- Agility.
- Vitality.
- Intelligence.
- Attack damage.
- Critical chance.
- Critical damage.
- Attack speed.
- Defense.
- Health regeneration.
- Life steal.

Higher rarity items can have more attributes and stronger bonuses.

5. UNIQUE ITEM EFFECTS

Legendary and higher rarity equipment can have unique effects.

Examples:

- Increased critical damage.
- Additional attack speed.
- Life steal.
- Magical damage.
- Summoned creature bonuses.
- Special combat effects.

6. DUNGEON LOOT

Create different loot tables for each dungeon.

Forgotten Catacombs:

- Ancient swords.
- Skeleton armor.
- Undead artifacts.

Abandoned Mines:

- Heavy axes.
- Mining armor.
- Rare accessories.

Dark Abyss:

- Shadow weapons.
- Dark armor.
- Magical artifacts.

Bosses must have exclusive equipment drops.

7. EQUIPMENT UPGRADES

Create an upgrade system from +0 to +20.

- Use gold and upgrade materials.
- Increase equipment attributes.
- Show upgrade animations.
- Include upgrade failure protection.
- Never delete valuable equipment unexpectedly.

8. ITEM MANAGEMENT

Implement:

- Inventory.
- Equipment comparison.
- Equip and unequip.
- Sell items for gold.
- Dismantle items.
- Equipment crafting.
- Item locking.
- Item sorting and filtering.

9. SET BONUSES

Create armor sets with bonuses.

Equipping 2, 4 or 6 pieces from the same set activates additional bonuses.

10. IMPORTANT BALANCE RULES

- Equipment rarity and character rank are separate.
- All rarity levels must be obtainable through gameplay.
- The best equipment must not be exclusively purchasable.
- Create balanced drop probabilities.
- Make boss rewards exciting and meaningful.

11. IMPLEMENTATION PRIORITY

Start with a functional inventory, equipment slots, random attributes, rarity system and drops from the Forgotten Catacombs boss.

Keep the system expandable for future dungeons and classes.

Do not create decorative menus without working functionality.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING** with a functional equipment, rarity, random attributes, inventory, and dungeon loot system without removing existing functionality.
- Prioritize inventory, equipment slots, random attributes, rarity, and Forgotten Catacombs boss drops; keep the system expandable.

## Requirements
- Eight rarities with distinct colors, effects, borders, and drop probabilities: Common gray, Uncommon green, Rare blue, Epic purple, Legendary orange, Mythic red, Divine gold, Transcendent cyan.
- Eight equipment slots: main weapon, helmet, chest armor, gloves, boots, necklace, ring, artifact.
- Support class-appropriate weapon types for Warrior, Assassin, Mage, and Necromancer.
- Generate random attributes; higher rarities provide more and stronger attributes. Legendary+ items may have unique effects.
- Dungeon-specific loot tables and exclusive boss equipment drops; begin with Forgotten Catacombs.
- Equipment upgrades from +0 to +20 using gold and upgrade materials, with upgrade animation and failure protection; never unexpectedly delete valuable equipment.
- Functional inventory features: compare, equip/unequip, sell, dismantle, craft, lock, sort, filter; armor set bonuses at 2, 4, and 6 pieces.
- All rarities must be obtainable through gameplay; equipment rarity is independent from character rank; best gear must not be paid-only.

## Decisions
- Maintain the existing browser game and its current functionality; implement actual working systems rather than decorative menus.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` for the existing equipment, loot, and UI implementations.

### Active
- Equipment currently has seven slots, seven rarities, basic randomized gear, and rudimentary equip/upgrade actions; extend these into the requested system.
- Implement equipment management, rarity visuals/effects, attributes, and Forgotten Catacombs boss-exclusive loot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Extend rarity and slot definitions, item generation, stats, and loot/drop tables in `game.js`.
2. Implement the functional inventory actions and upgrades up to +20, retaining valuable items and existing features.
3. Update equipment panel rendering and rarity/upgrade presentation in `game.js` and `styles.css`.
4. Run syntax and browser-flow checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing item generation (`makeItem`), drops (`dropItem`), inventory panel (`renderPanel`), item display (`itemMarkup`), and gear actions (`handlePanelAction`).
- `styles.css`: Existing panel and item styling; add rarity-specific presentation and upgrade effects.
- `index.html`: Main HUD and navigation; equipment panel is dynamically rendered from `game.js`.

## Important Context
- Existing rarity list is `RARITIES` with seven entries, ending at Divine; slot map `SLOT_NAMES` has seven slots and lacks Artifact.
- Save key is `rank-up-awakening-v1`; state gear is keyed by slots, inventory is an array, and gear upgrades currently increment without a cap or materials.
- `makeItem()` currently produces basic attack/crit or defense/vitality stats; `dropItem()` chooses random slots and does not use dungeon-specific tables or exclusive boss items.
- Repository changes were reported as uncommitted; project files were reported as untracked.

RANK UP: THE AWAKENING — HUNTER AWAKENING SYSTEM.

Expand the existing game without removing any existing systems.


Create a deep character awakening and talent progression system.


VISUAL STYLE:
High-quality realistic 3D anime dark fantasy.
Cinematic awakening transformations.
Glowing magical energy, particles and unique character effects.


1. AWAKENING LEVELS


Create five awakening stages:


- Dormant.
- Awakened.
- Evolved.
- Transcendent.
- Sovereign.


Each stage requires specific character levels, achievements and awakening quests.


2. AWAKENING QUESTS


Create special missions that test the player's strength.


Include:


- Powerful enemy encounters.
- Dungeon challenges.
- Boss battles.
- Special awakening trials.


3. CLASS AWAKENING


Create unique awakening abilities for each class.


WARRIOR:


- Absolute Fury.
- Titan's Defense.


ASSASSIN:


- Shadow Step.
- Phantom Execution.


MAGE:


- Arcane Storm.
- Elemental Overload.


NECROMANCER:


- Army of the Dead.
- Soul Harvest.


4. TALENT TREE


Create a functional talent tree with six branches:


- Attack.
- Defense.
- Agility.
- Magic.
- Summoning.
- Critical Damage.


Players earn talent points through character progression.


5. UNIQUE POWERS


Create rare abilities obtainable through:


- Special quests.
- Secret bosses.
- Rare dungeon rewards.
- Awakening milestones.


6. VISUAL TRANSFORMATIONS


Each awakening stage should visually transform the character.


Add:


- Magical aura.
- Glowing eyes.
- Energy particles.
- Unique skill effects.
- Special transformation animation.


7. BALANCE


Awakening must complement the existing rank, class, equipment and level systems.


Do not make any awakening stage exclusively purchasable.


All major awakening progress must be achievable through gameplay.


8. IMPLEMENTATION


Start with a functional Dormant-to-Awakened progression.


Build the remaining stages as expandable systems.


Preserve all existing game functionality.

RANK UP: THE AWAKENING — COMPANIONS AND SUMMONING SYSTEM.

Expand the existing game without removing any previous functionality.

Create a complete companion system for the 3D anime dark fantasy idle RPG.

1. COMPANION CATEGORIES

Create five companion categories:

- Warrior: melee damage.
- Assassin: critical damage and speed.
- Guardian: defense and protection.
- Mage: magical damage.
- Creature: special abilities.

2. COMPANION EXAMPLES

Create original companions:

- Shadow Wolf.
- Spectral Knight.
- Aether Dragon.
- Ancient Golem.
- Soul Reaper.
- Celestial Guardian.

3. COMPANION RARITIES

- Common.
- Rare.
- Epic.
- Legendary.
- Mythic.
- Divine.
- Transcendent.

Each rarity has different attributes, appearance and abilities.

4. COMPANION PROGRESSION

Every companion must have:

- Individual level.
- Experience.
- Strength.
- Vitality.
- Agility.
- Intelligence.
- Unique abilities.
- Evolution stages.

5. ACTIVE COMPANION SYSTEM

- Start with 3 active companion slots.
- Unlock up to 5 slots through gameplay progression.
- Allow players to select their active team before entering dungeons.
- Automatically summon active companions during combat.
- Companions attack enemies automatically.
- Companions can have support and healing abilities.
- Show companion health bars.

6. CLASS SYNERGY

Create special class interactions.

WARRIOR:
Companions gain defensive bonuses.

ASSASSIN:
Companions gain critical damage bonuses.

MAGE:
Companions gain magical damage bonuses.

NECROMANCER:
Special shadow summoning system.
Allow defeated enemies to become eligible shadow summons through special gameplay mechanics.

7. COMPANION EVOLUTION

Allow companions to evolve using:

- Experience.
- Gold.
- Evolution materials.
- Special dungeon drops.

Evolution changes their appearance and improves their abilities.

8. COMPANION COLLECTION

Create a dedicated collection screen.

Include:

- Owned companions.
- Locked companions.
- Companion descriptions.
- Rarity.
- Level.
- Attributes.
- Skills.
- Evolution progression.

9. COMPANION BALANCE

Companions must be obtainable through gameplay.

Aether may be used for optional cosmetic companion skins and convenience items, but the strongest companions must not be exclusive to paying players.

10. FIRST IMPLEMENTATION

Start with:

- Shadow Wolf.
- Spectral Knight.
- Ancient Golem.
- Three active slots.
- Automatic companion combat.
- Individual companion levels.
- Basic companion interface.

Keep all systems expandable for future updates.

Preserve all existing game functionality.

## Objective
- Expand **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING** while preserving existing gameplay, completing the equipment/inventory progression, and adding a functional character awakening and talent system.
- Begin with Dormant-to-Awakened progression; keep later stages expandable and achievable through gameplay.

## Requirements
- Awakening stages: Dormant, Awakened, Evolved, Transcendent, Sovereign; progression requires character levels, achievements, quests, trials, and boss/dungeon challenges.
- Add class-specific awakening abilities: Warrior—Absolute Fury, Titan’s Defense; Assassin—Shadow Step, Phantom Execution; Mage—Arcane Storm, Elemental Overload; Necromancer—Army of the Dead, Soul Harvest.
- Add a functional six-branch talent tree: Attack, Defense, Agility, Magic, Summoning, Critical Damage; award points through character progression.
- Provide unique powers via quests, secret bosses, rare dungeon rewards, and awakening milestones.
- Add cinematic visual transformations with aura, glowing eyes, energy particles, skill effects, and animation; preserve the high-quality realistic 3D anime dark-fantasy style.
- Awakening must complement rank, class, equipment, and level; no awakening stage may be purchasable exclusively.
- Equipment system scope remains: eight rarities and slots, randomized/class-appropriate gear, Legendary+ effects, dungeon/boss loot, safe +0–+20 upgrades, functional inventory actions, and armor set bonuses.

## Decisions
- Maintain the existing browser game and its current functionality; implement working systems rather than decorative menus.
- Start awakening implementation with functional Dormant-to-Awakened progression; leave later stages expandable.

## Work State
### Completed
- `game.js` has eight rarities and weights, eight equipment slots, class-specific weapon pools, Catacomb Vanguard bonuses, boss-exclusive relics, inventory/material defaults, set-bonus stat aggregation, randomized item generation, capacity-aware loot handling, boss relic rewards, and enemy upgrade-material drops.
- Inspected the actual gear panel branch, item renderer, event handler, combat/stat functions, save defaults, and `index.html` navigation to prepare further changes.

### Active
- Implement Dormant-to-Awakened progression, its gameplay quest requirements, unlock action/UI, and initial transformation visuals.
- Design awakening/talent state integration with existing level, class, rank, combat, and save systems.
- Complete the unfinished gear UI/actions, safe capped upgrades, and rarity/inventory styling.

### Blocked
- Gear panel remains on its old implementation; the earlier exact-text replacement failed because the source did not match. The actual source is now inspected, but no replacement or follow-up implementation has been applied.

## Next Move
1. Add backward-compatible awakening and talent defaults to `freshState()` / `loadState()`, then define stage requirements and gameplay-earned progression.
2. Implement the Dormant-to-Awakened quest/progress UI and action, including achievement and boss/dungeon checks.
3. Add initial awakening combat bonuses/ability and visible 3D transformation effects.
4. Implement talent point earning and a functional six-branch talent allocation UI.
5. Resume the gear panel from the exact current branch near `game.js:174`; add inventory actions and guaranteed +0–+20 upgrades.
6. Add styles and run syntax/gameplay checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Existing save state, combat/stat functions, 3D hunter, rendering, panel UI, and action handlers.
- `index.html`: Current navigation and combat HUD; panels are dynamically rendered by `game.js`.
- `styles.css`: Existing visual system; awakening, talent, and inventory styling remains to be added.

## Important Context
- Save key is `rank-up-awakening-v1`; existing saves are merged with fresh defaults in `loadState()`.
- Current state has `level`, `kills`, `bossKills`, `completedDungeons`, `classKey`, `attributePoints`, and `gear`, but no awakening or talent state.
- `gainXp()` currently grants 3 attribute points per level.
- Gear panel old branch is around `game.js:174–175`; old `itemMarkup()` is around line 192; `handlePanelAction()` only has basic equip and uncapped gold-only upgrades around lines 196–210.
- No changes were made in the latest conversation after inspecting these files.

## Objective
- Expand **RANK UP: THE AWAKENING** with functional awakening, talent, equipment, and companion progression while preserving existing gameplay.
- Start with Dormant-to-Awakened progression and three initial companions; keep later stages expandable.

## Requirements
- Add class-specific awakening abilities, six functional talent branches, and gameplay-earned talent points.
- Complete equipment rarities and slots, inventory actions, upgrades capped at +20, Legendary+ effects, loot, and armor set bonuses.
- Add companions with categories, rarities, individual progression, abilities, evolution, collection/team UI, automatic combat, and health bars.
- Start with three active companion slots; unlock up to five through gameplay.
- Companion acquisition must be gameplay-based; Aether may offer cosmetics or convenience, not exclusive strongest companions.

## Decisions
- Preserve the existing browser game and current functionality.
- Begin with Dormant-to-Awakened progression and three initial companions; keep later stages and features expandable.

### Completed
- Added companion HP persistence, active-companion lookup, talent rank/damage helpers, unique equipment checks, companion unlock eligibility and XP/leveling helpers, awakening evaluation, and companion damage/HP helpers.
- Added Allies navigation, companion HUD container, and initial companion, talent, and awakening styling.
- Fixed `defense()` set-bonus precedence; Ancient Golem’s defense bonus requires it to be alive.
- Kingbreaker, Undying, and Royal Aegis relics contribute unique effects to hunter stats.
- Companion unlocks auto-fill the first active slot when none are occupied; gameplay unlocks slot 4 at 20 kills and slot 5 after three boss victories.
- Awakening evaluation requires a selected class as well as level 5 and a boss victory.

### Active
- Wire companion unlock/progression, automatic combat, health bars, and collection/team UI into gameplay.
- Build awakening and talent UI/actions; award gameplay-earned talent points and apply branch and class-ability effects in combat.
- Finish equipment interactions; enforce the +20 cap and material costs.
- Run syntax and gameplay checks; inspect and correct remaining stat/logic issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Wire `unlockEligibleCompanions()`, `awardCompanionXp()`, and `evaluateAwakening()` into gameplay events.
2. Add companion HUD health bars, automatic attacks, and collection/team actions.
3. Build awakening and talent panels/actions; award gameplay-earned talent points and apply branch and class-ability effects in combat.
4. Enforce equipment upgrade cap and material costs; complete inventory actions.
5. Run syntax and gameplay checks and fix remaining issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, combat, panels, action handlers, and progression systems.
- `index.html`: Navigation and combat HUD, including Allies entry and companion HUD container.
- `styles.css`: Interface styling, including initial companion, talent, and awakening styles.

- Equipment upgrades still spend gold without enforcing a +20 cap or consuming upgrade materials.
- Latest inspection made no edits; repository files are uncommitted/untracked, and no checks have been run.
